title: Photovoltaic panels and modules.
officialText:
Photovoltaic panels and modules mounted on top of a roof shall be listed and
labeled in accordance with UL 1703 and shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's installation instructions.
SECTION BC 1510
REROOFING
